findings.summary: Focused tests are false-green because the approved cited Brain maintenance capability/workflow remains scaffold-level and unintegrated.
findings.details: S08-T04 requires a generated capability and workflow that gather immutable routed context, return cited no-op/revision proposals, enforce all declared maintenance typed failures, support review-first/autopilot downgrade semantics, and prove review accept/edit/reject and duplicate attempt behavior. The implemented maintainBrainPage Confect contract still exposes generic workspaceSlug/input args, returns only accepted/summary, declares only generic auth/validation errors, and the impl returns canned data. The sourceToBrainMaintenance graph/test remain source-to-output scaffold and never invoke maintenance capability/commit behavior. Pure helper tests cover a subset of policy checks but do not prove the task contract end-to-end, so the pre-review gates can pass while the core approved behavior is missing.
